prompt: Which statements about runner models are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Managed versus owned is the whole trade: GitHub hosts and refreshes theirs; yours bring control and responsibility. Public repositories are the documented anti-case for self-hosting, and no hosted runner ever joins your private network.

options.text: GitHub-hosted runners are maintained, patched, and provided fresh per job by GitHub
Self-hosted runners suit custom hardware, private networks, and OS control
Self-hosted runners are recommended for public repositories
Runner groups scope which repositories may use a set of self-hosted runners
GitHub-hosted runners can join your VPN automatically
